title: Felix Firefly's Night-Light Parade | Pattern Story for Kids

music.transition_family: hard cut on matched glow direction with occasional sound-leading J-cut
music.emotional_arrangement: soft celesta and brushed frame drum opening; pizzicato curiosity; muted low strings during Felix's dim moment; bells, hand percussion and warm chorus at the parade climax

voices.delivery: melodic story-song with acted character phrases; no flat narrator

composition.frame: 16:9 with 5 percent title-safe margin, 12-column grid and 8-pixel baseline
composition.hierarchy: one luminous focal action per shot; Felix is primary, friend reaction is secondary, foliage is ambient
composition.depth: foreground foliage 1.2x, character/path midground 0.6x, moonlit forest background 0.2x parallax
composition.camera: one slow push or follow per phrase, never push-pan-rotate together

scenes.action: Felix finds Rabbit and Hedgehog waiting beside exactly three unlit leaf lanterns.
lyrics: Moonlight rests on the woodland trail.
Three little lanterns have lost their glow.
Felix says, we can light the way.

scenes.action: Felix demonstrates gold-blue-gold over three physical stepping leaves; Rabbit repeats it and the first lantern lights.
lyrics: Glow gold, then blue, then gold again.
Rabbit taps the pattern slowly.
The first leaf lantern shines awake.
scenes.hero: three readable colour steps leading to one lit lantern

scenes.action: Hedgehog carries the small lantern through blue-gold-blue pools; the second path lantern lights.
lyrics: Blue, gold, blue along the moss.
Hedgehog walks each colour with care.
A second lantern warms the trail.
scenes.hero: Hedgehog's planted steps and carried lantern

scenes.action: The wind hides the stepping-leaf colours. Children repeat both patterns while Felix points to the same physical route.
lyrics: The breeze has covered every clue.
Can you sing the colours with us?
Gold-blue-gold, then blue-gold-blue.
scenes.hero: leaves revealed one at a time by the sung pattern

scenes.action: Felix's light becomes small after guiding everyone. Rabbit shelters him with a leaf while Hedgehog raises the first two lanterns nearby.
lyrics: Felix's tiny light grows tired.
Friends bring shelter, warmth and time.
A quiet glow can still be brave.
scenes.hero: Felix resting safely under one leaf shelter

scenes.action: Felix and friends combine gold-blue-gold-blue into one four-beat pattern that lights the third lantern and arch.
lyrics: One friend starts, and one joins in.
Gold-blue-gold-blue, steady and bright.
The final lantern opens the way.
scenes.hero: third lantern illuminating exactly on the fourth beat

scenes.action: Rabbit, Hedgehog and Felix follow the three lit lanterns; woodland neighbours join behind without overtaking the trio.
lyrics: Three warm lanterns guide the woodland.
Little feet and wings move together.
Every pattern leads us home.
scenes.hero: trio moving left-to-right through the lantern arch

scenes.action: The lantern path becomes a restrained woodland parade; both learned patterns return in the original final song.
lyrics: Gold-blue-gold, our lights remember.
Blue-gold-blue, our friends stay near.
Shine together through the night.
scenes.hero: Felix leads one radiant musical climax and lands in a stable final pose

quality_requirements: Exactly three story lanterns remain traceable across all scenes.
Felix, Rabbit and Hedgehog retain their opening identities and tactile material treatment.
Every visible colour pattern matches the sung order for the full phrase.
No lantern lights before its narrated pattern succeeds.
Felix's dim moment is tender and safe, never frightening or medicalized.
Real wing, leaf, step, lantern and wind effects replace spoken imitation words.
The parade and final-song staging appear only in scene 8.
All shared set gates in premium-musical-video-set-2026-08-31.json pass before release.
